languages.value: 33 languages, translation between any pair; includes en, fr, de, it
languages.note: Full list: zh, en, fr, pt, es, ja, tr, ru, ar, ko, th, it, de, vi, ms, id, tl, hi, zh-Hant, pl, cs, nl, km, my, fa, gu, ur, te, mr, he, bn, ta, uk, bo, kk, mn, ug, yue. Missing: Romansh, Swiss German, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Catalan.

runtimes.value: llama.cpp llama-server with official GGUF (tencent, also unsloth, mradermacher); Ollama via hf.co GGUF or community tags (kaelri/hy-mt2, maternion/hy-mt2); LM Studio (GGUF); mlx-lm with mlx-community builds (4bit, 8bit, bf16); transformers (MPS unverified)
runtimes.note: No official Ollama library tag. A May 2026 article ran the 1.8B GGUF on llama.cpp (M1 Max) and said the 1.8B/7B GGUFs were the Mac options; the 7B itself was not tested there.

web.verdict: Little feedback; small dedicated translation model, 33 languages
web.summary: Strong dedicated translation model, EN/FR/DE/IT included; little feedback, and no user comparison found with general LLMs such as Qwen3.8-27B or gpt-oss-120b.
web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments (Algolia API). Reddit, Hugging Face discussions and runtime issues not read.

comments.text: Technical comment on its 1.25-bit variant; no hands-on report on translation quality ([HN, 48991840](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48991840)).
The authors' paper claims it beats strong open models; no per-language tables in the summaries found (authors' claim, not user feedback) ([arXiv 2605.22064](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.22064)).
